Eval judges and grader move to Claude Opus 5.5

The operator chose to move the eval judge and grader defaults off older Opus ids, with one paid baseline rerun per suite after merge. This PR changes the defaults only. It spends nothing.

The judge stays a different model from the agent (claude-sonnet-5), so the self-preference rule in run-plugin-eval.sh still holds. Every default stays overridable (the judge flags on both scripts, and EVAL_GRADING_MODEL for the grader).

Suite 2 is dominated by agent spend: on 2026-09-12 the agent cost $3.06 and the judge $0.07, and Opus 5.5 lists 20 percent below Opus 5. Suite 3 has no recorded cost, so it is marked ?; do a dry run first to print the case count. If suite 1 shows the same agreement with the hand verdicts as the 2026-09-12 calibration, suite 2 can wait.
